key.name: font-size
key.description: Controls the size of the clock display relative to the base font size

key.name: clock-color
key.description: Choose the color theme for the clock display

key.name: custom-color
key.description: Hex color code used when clock-color is set to custom

key.name: glow-intensity
key.description: Controls the glow effect for colored themes or shadow strength for retro LCD

key.name: clock-format-24h
key.description: Display time in 24-hour format instead of AM/PM

key.name: show-seconds
key.description: Display seconds in the time display

key.name: blink-dots
key.description: Make the time separators blink for classic LCD effect

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Choose where the clock appears on the panel

key.name: alarm-enabled
key.description: Deprecated since 60, kept only so upgrades from versions before 60 can migrate into the alarms list

key.name: alarm-hour
key.description: Deprecated since 60, kept only so upgrades from versions before 60 can migrate into the alarms list

key.name: alarm-minute
key.description: Deprecated since 60, kept only so upgrades from versions before 60 can migrate into the alarms list

key.name: alarm-message
key.description: Deprecated since 60, kept only so upgrades from versions before 60 can migrate into the alarms list

key.name: alarms
key.description: JSON array of alarm objects, each with id, hour, minute, enabled, label and optional year/month/day for a one-time alarm on a specific date (omitted means the alarm repeats every day)

key.name: alarms-migrated
key.description: Internal flag tracking whether the pre-60 single alarm was migrated into the alarms list

key.name: snooze-minutes
key.description: How many minutes to wait before a snoozed alarm rings again

key.name: test-alarm-counter
key.description: Incremented by the preferences window to ask the running extension to play the alarm sound once, as a preview

key.name: test-alarm-stop-counter
key.description: Incremented by the preferences window to ask the running extension to stop the test alarm sound preview

key.name: show-date
key.description: Display current date below the time

key.name: is-widget
key.description: Show clock on desktop instead of the top bar

key.name: widget-x
key.description: Horizontal position of the desktop widget

key.name: widget-y
key.description: Vertical position of the desktop widget

key.name: flicker-enabled
key.description: Add subtle random flicker for vintage LCD display feel

key.name: font-style
key.description: Choose the font style (synthetic bold/italic by Pango)

key.name: ghost-segments
key.description: Show the unlit 7-segment pattern faintly behind the active digits

key.name: startup-lamp-test
key.description: Briefly flash all segments at full brightness when the extension starts

key.name: minute-flicker
key.description: Dip the display brightness briefly whenever the minute changes

key.name: crt-scanlines
key.description: Overlay faint horizontal scanlines across the display for a CRT/VFD look

key.name: alarm-dialog-enabled
key.description: Show a modal on-screen dialog instead of a notification when an alarm triggers, so alarms are not missed when notifications are silenced (e.g. Do Not Disturb). When disabled, falls back to the regular notification.

key.name: show-frame
key.description: Show the border outline around the display. Disable to hide just the border line; the background and glow stay visible either way.
